# HAIRLINE — Type Arcade & Typing Defense

> Minimalist hairline-illustrated typing arcade and isometric lane-defense web games with real-time D3 WPM trend graphing.

## Modes
- **Home (`/#home`)**: Desktop and mobile-native onboarding deck introducing both typing games, zero-backspace positional typing, clean-word shields, Ink turret economy, and D3 speed charts.
- **Type Arcade**: Side-scrolling 2D Canvas typing shooter (`960×420` HiDPI). Type approaching words cleanly to shoot, heal `+2 HP`, and raise a deflecting shield; typos trigger enemy return fire (`-8 HP`).
- **Typing Defense**: Isometric 3D-projected SVG lane-defense game (`960×430`). Defend the Keep across three lanes, earn Ink per keystroke, spend `25 / 45 / 70 Ink` via keys `1–3` to build/upgrade automated lane turrets, and survive endless waves.

## Telemetry & Features
- Zero-backspace positional typing engine with target switching on word-start.
- Web Audio API procedural sound effects (mute state saved in `localStorage`).
- Light and Dark hairline plate themes (theme saved in `localStorage`).
- D3.js post-run WPM trend graph (`WpmTrendChart`) showing peak, average, and end WPM.
- One-click Twitter/X, Facebook, clipboard summary, and 1080×1080 PNG card export for Instagram.

## Documentation
- `/AGENTS.md`: Architecture and development conventions for coding agents.
- `/llm.md`: Detailed game rules, mechanics, and controls reference.
